mapper.select: SELECT w.wishlist_id AS wishlistId, w.member_id AS memberId, w.product_id AS productId, w.created_at AS createdAt, p.name AS productName, p.name_en AS productNameEn, p.code AS productCode, p.price AS price, p.discount_price AS discountPrice, (SELECT image_url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY sort_order ASC LIMIT 1) AS productImage FROM wishlist w JOIN product p ON w.product_id = p.product_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM wishlist WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wishlist (member_id, product_id) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}) ON CONFLICT (member_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlist WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}
